scientific_question: Can a fit-only observation-space reduced residual solve replace the parent dual CNN on every odd frame, preserve the frozen field/gradient/observation compatibility envelope after strict CGLS K1, and reduce complete A/A-transpose calls plus end-to-end wall time without material peak-RSS growth?

frozen_algorithm.name: Observable Reduced Residual Warm K1
frozen_algorithm.keyframes: even frames 0,2,...,100 use the frozen parent dual CNN
frozen_algorithm.skipped_frames: odd frames 1,3,...,99 use no parent CNN evaluation
frozen_algorithm.fit_innovation: parent dual proposal at odd frame minus preceding even frame
frozen_algorithm.fit_weighting: equal total centered innovation energy per complete fit trajectory
frozen_algorithm.online_input: current observation, preceding even-frame observation-space proposal and its exact A-transpose lift/projection, fixed fit-only package, frozen geometry
frozen_algorithm.online_residual: r = y_odd - A h_even - A mean_lift
frozen_algorithm.coefficient_rule: c = argmin ||M c - r||_2^2 + lambda ||c||_2^2, with M=A B and the closed-form map stored offline
frozen_algorithm.refinement: unchanged strict CGLS K1 with observable-only alpha in [0,2]

frozen_resource_gate.peak_RSS_scope: parent os.wait4 child ru_maxrss; worker receives only observations.npy and spawns no subprocesses

development_evidence_before_freeze.interpretation: the defensible mechanism is the observation-only reduced residual solve; physical tangent enrichment is not uniquely necessary

confirmatory_decision.invalid_first_test: p=22kw_size=05 was opened by the v23.0 release but the pair builder stopped before frame access because the legacy verified bundle class prohibited test split; it is excluded from all confirmatory claims
confirmatory_decision.pass_remaining_test: the frozen remaining p=58kw_size=01 trajectory passes both accuracy masks, exact online ledger, deterministic output, wall gate and RSS gate, and an independent validator reproduces package action, predictions, metrics, ledgers and benchmark statistics
confirmatory_decision.fail: any accuracy, ledger, determinism, wall or RSS gate fails
confirmatory_decision.invalid: the source, package, checkpoint, geometry, release, raw test identity or report template differs from the frozen bindings
